description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay in minutes for flights on an origin-destination route; negative values indicate early departures.
source: Derived from the dep_delay column in the nycflights13 flights table.
transformation_or_derivation: Flights were grouped by origin and dest, then the mean of dep_delay was calculated for each route.
notes_or_concerns: avg_dep_delay is missing for route(s): EWR-LGA. Departure delay is only known at or after departure, so it could create a timing or data-leakage concern if the prediction is made before departure.

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Maximum arrival delay in minutes among flights on an origin-destination route; negative values mean even the latest recorded arrival was early.
source: Derived from the arr_delay column in the nycflights13 flights table.
transformation_or_derivation: Flights were grouped by origin and dest, then the maximum arr_delay was calculated for each route.
notes_or_concerns: A negative value is not necessarily an error. Routes with very few flights can have unusual maximum values because the statistic is based on a small number of observations.

description: Average flight distance for flights on an origin-destination route.
source: Derived from the distance column in the nycflights13 flights table.
transformation_or_derivation: Flights were grouped by origin and dest, then the mean distance was calculated for each route.
notes_or_concerns: This is a route-level summary, so it should be interpreted as the average across the flights represented in that route.

description: Average air time in minutes for flights on an origin-destination route.
source: Derived from the air_time column in the nycflights13 flights table.
transformation_or_derivation: Flights were grouped by origin and dest, then the mean air_time was calculated for each route.
notes_or_concerns: Pandas mean excludes missing air_time values, so some route averages may be based on fewer flights than the route's flight_count.

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

source: Taken from the lat column in the nycflights13 airports table.
transformation_or_derivation: The airports table was joined to the route ABT by matching the route destination code to the airport FAA code.
notes_or_concerns: Destination coordinates may be missing when the destination code does not have a matching record in the airports lookup table.

source: Taken from the lon column in the nycflights13 airports table.
transformation_or_derivation: The airports table was joined to the route ABT by matching the route destination code to the airport FAA code.
notes_or_concerns: Destination coordinates may be missing when the destination code does not have a matching record in the airports lookup table.
